b.label: Advanced Aerospace Threat Identification Program (AATIP / AAITP)

edges.label: Ran the program from c.2010 to 2017 (asserted); role denied by DoD
edges.note: Elizondo states he ran AATIP; TTSA said he took it over as Director in 2010. The Department has denied he had assigned responsibilities since June 2019 without ever addressing why he processed the program's imagery in 2017.

edges.label: Direct correspondence, 5 June 2019 and 3 June 2020: 'I ran the program'
edges.note: Released in the Department's own reading room under FOIA 21-F-0938. He also gave her a list of people who could confirm his role. The Department's response, if any, has not been released in full.

edges.label: FOIA release of the Elizondo-Gough correspondence
edges.note: The Department's own reading room hosts the most detailed public rebuttal of the Department's position on Elizondo.

edges.label: 'no assigned responsibilities for AATIP'
edges.note: Issued in response to the authenticated Harry Reid memorandum, with the assertion that the memo 'makes no change to previous statements'. She added that DIA administered AATIP and Elizondo was never assigned to DIA.
